manifest.name: dsh-workbuddy-connect
manifest.description: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring WorkBuddy desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build

bundle.text:
# Register the WorkBuddy provider without changing the profile's current
# default model. The plugin reuses the WorkBuddy desktop app's sign-in; no
# separate OAuth flow is started.
- insert:
    - id: llm-workbuddy
      name: dsh-workbuddy-connect

readme.text:
[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

> [!WARNING]
> **安装后不能直接使用：对话请求会被 WorkBuddy 上游以 HTTP 400 拒绝。**
>
> 这是**上游对非官方客户端的接入限制**（会按系统提示词 / 客户端身份识别），**不是本插件的安装、打包或配置问题**。插件仍能安装，模型分组和登录状态也可能正常，但真正发起对话时可能直接返回 400。
>
> 本仓库**不提供绕过方案**。使用者在安装前应自行评估并**自行解决**该限制，或**等待作者其他仓库的后续更新**；在限制解除或上游放行前，请勿把 400 当作安装失败来反复重装。
>
> 最稳妥的方式仍是使用官方 WorkBuddy 客户端。

本仓库是 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 的社区维护分支，由 [longge1213812138](https://github.com/longge1213812138) 接手维护，基于原作者 [corrinehu](https://github.com/corrinehu) 的 v0.7.9（MIT）继续开发。原仓库已宣布停止维护；本仓库保留完整历史、许可证和贡献者署名。

**风险提示**：WorkBuddy 已开始限制非官方客户端请求。本分支**不会绕过**官方校验或限制，也不保证相关接口长期可用；上游一旦收紧限制，插件可能失效。请先阅读文末「免责声明」，自行评估账号风险。使用官方 WorkBuddy 客户端始终是最安全的选择。

---

将已登录的 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 桌面应用中可用的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness；两版分别显示各自的模型分组，并沿用各自的账号登录与积分。

**前置**：本机已安装并登录 WorkBuddy（国内版）或 WorkBuddy AI 桌面 App。插件直接复用 App 的登录状态，账号切换自动跟随，两版互不影响。

**当前主线适配 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.3`**；其他内核请先看文末「版本兼容与历史版本」，不要强行安装 main。

**推荐：把安装交给本机已有的 Agent**——任何具备终端与文件操作能力的助手（DSH Agent、Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等）都可以，把下面这段话原样发给它：

```text
请帮我安装并验证 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件 dsh-workbuddy-connect，源码仓库：https://github.com/longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect
先阅读仓库 README，确认我实际使用的界面（Web / Desktop / TUI）与 DSH 内核版本；桌面版以 App 内置核心为准，不要用独立 CLI 的版本代替。
本仓库当前主线只适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。版本匹配时，从我的 GitHub 仓库源码安装，不要安装 npm 上同名的旧包：
  dsh plugin --profile web add --config.strict-dep-builds=false github:longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect

内核与安装来源速查（完整表见文末）：

| DSH 内核 | 安装来源 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.3` | 本仓库 `main`（0.8.2） |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | 本仓库 `main`（0.8.2） |
| `0.2.1-rc.1` | 上游 npm `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.7` |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | 上游 npm `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.6` |
| `0.2.0-rc.1` | 上游 npm `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.0` |
| `0.1.5` – `0.1.7` | 上游 npm `dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.6.5` |

<details>
<summary>手动安装（命令行，仅 Web / TUI）</summary>

```sh

readme.section: Web：从本仓库源码安装（当前主线，DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add --config.strict-dep-builds=false github:longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect
dsh web

readme.section: 或固定到某个发布 tag（推荐生产使用）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add --config.strict-dep-builds=false github:longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect#v0.8.2

readme.section: TUI：0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3 内核用上面的源码安装；更旧或更新的内核按上表安装对应版本
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.6.5
dsh --profile dsh-tui
```

</details>

> **安装报 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`**：DSH 的 pnpm 11 会把 `@google/genai`、`protobufjs` 的构建脚本拦截视为错误。插件 `lib/` 已预构建，不依赖这些脚本；上面的命令已加 `--config.strict-dep-builds=false`，把该拦截从错误降为警告。若仍失败，把 `pnpm.log` 贴给 Agent，不要用 `pnpm approve-builds` 或修改依赖包。

> **TUI 版本搭配**：终端壳 `@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui` 需 0.10.0-beta.5 及以上，更早版本装本插件会启动失败（`events is not iterable`）；推理档位的手动检测仅 Web / Desktop 提供，TUI 没有。

readme.section: TUI：0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3 内核用上面的源码安装；更旧或更新的内核按上表安装对应版本
readme.text:
> **Desktop**：部分 Desktop 发行版（尤其官方 Electron 版）的 `desktop` profile 由 App 管理，官方版会直接拒绝独立 CLI 的 `--profile desktop`；其他发行版规则未必相同，请先检查你所用的发行版，不要盲用独立 CLI 的 `--profile desktop`。可以让 Agent 探查是否有合规的非市场安装路径，但不保证可行；切勿盲改 App 管理的目录或绕过其校验。

**验证**：重启对应界面后，模型选择器出现「WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI」分组（只装一版就只验对应一组），并从分组里选一个模型完成一次简短对话、能正常回复，才算安装成功。

```text
你是 dsh-workbuddy-connect 维护分支（https://github.com/longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的维护 Agent。请先完整阅读 README.md、package.json、cordis.patch.yml、src/update.ts，并用 dsh --version 确认本机 DSH 内核版本（桌面版以 App 内置核心为准）。
维护规则：
1. 先安装依赖并运行完整检查：npx pnpm@10 install --frozen-lockfile && npx pnpm@10 run check。任何改动都必须让 typecheck、test、build 全部通过；不要通过删测试或放宽断言来“修复”。
2. 兼容性声明写在 package.json 的 engines.dsh（当前 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3）：DSH 运行时的兼容性预检一旦看到 engines.dsh 就只认它，peerDependencies 全部忽略。它必须是可以逐个追加的显式白名单，不要用 caret 自动放宽；每验证一个新内核就手工追加一段，并同步 tests/version.spec.ts 的断言。升级内核时还要同步 peer/dev 版本、pnpm-lock.yaml，以及 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt（如涉及）。

常用命令：

```sh
npx pnpm@10 install --frozen-lockfile
npx pnpm@10 run check
git add -A
git commit -m "fix: ..."

> Windows 提示：如果终端已设置 `WSLENV`，先执行 `env -u WSLENV npx pnpm@10 run check`；否则 `tests/issue-133-wslenv-helper-env.spec.ts` 会因环境污染失败。

维护边界：

- 本仓库只保证 `package.json` 中 `engines.dsh` 列出的内核可用；其他内核使用上表的历史版本，或先装到对应内核实测后再追加白名单。
- 不接收绕过 WorkBuddy 客户端校验、破解额度或伪造身份的改动。
- 上游私有接口变化导致无法修复时，保留失败原因和日志位置，并在 README 的「已知限制」中记录。

- **开箱即用**：安装并启用插件后即可在 DSH 中直接使用，无需额外配置。

- **国内版与国际版并存**：国内版显示为「WorkBuddy」分组，国际版（WorkBuddy AI）显示为「WorkBuddy AI」分组，两版的模型、账号和积分互不混用。各自只跟随对应 App 的登录状态：只装国际版就只出现 WorkBuddy AI，两版都装则两组并存，退出一版则对应分组消失。设置里两张卡片分别展示各自账号与余额。

- **图片输入**：大部分模型支持在对话里直接粘贴或拖入图片（GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4 系列等）；少数纯文字模型（如 GLM-5.1、GLM-5.2）会明确提示不支持。

- **推理档位**：WorkBuddy 明确声明的档位会直接显示，例如 GLM-5.3 和 GLM-5.3-Flash 可选 low / high / max。未声明档位的模型可在 Web 和 Desktop 的模型选择器中手动检测（发送少量请求，可能消耗积分）；未检测或没有可用档位的模型使用 WorkBuddy 默认档位。

- **余额速览**：选中 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 模型时，输入框底部在模型选择器旁显示当前账号的剩余积分（如 `WB.3,401（积分）`、国际版 `WB AI.3,401（积分）`）。积分不自动轮询（每次读取都是真实计费查询），挂载时读取一次后可点积分文字前方的 ↻ 手动刷新。切换会话时组件可能短暂隐藏，模型选择就绪后自动恢复；即使模型没有推理档位检测入口或余额读取失败，刷新按钮仍保留。

- **信息查看与检测**：设置 → 插件 → 对应卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期、剩余积分和模型优惠，也可手动刷新模型列表并查看当前列表来自上游还是内置兜底，或对可检测模型手动检测推理档位。DSH 0.1.5 的入口在「设置 → 插件」，0.1.6+ 移到主界面左侧栏「插件」面板（workbuddy-connect → 查看）；「设置 → 模型」页两代都不显示 WorkBuddy 条目，属有意设计。

- **模型显隐**：两张卡片的「上下文窗口」标签里可勾选要在模型选择器中显示的模型。隐藏配置按登录账号分别保存：切换账号自动切换各自配置，切回后恢复；新账号和新上架模型默认显示。隐藏只影响选择器中的可选性，正在使用该模型的已有会话不受影响。

同一份界面在 DSH 0.1.5 的设置卡片中原样生效：

- **企业账号积分**：国内版企业账号（`enterpriseId` 非空）走企业计费接口读取周期额度，卡片显示「企业额度」与周期重置时间。

- **费率比例**：每个模型名后直接显示积分倍率（如 `GLM-5.2 · x0.79`、`Hy3 · x0.00`），`/model` 弹窗与输入框的模型下拉都能看到；倍率仅用于显示，不影响实际请求。

- **徽章展示**：促销徽章（限时免费、夜间折扣）直接跟在模型名后（如 `Hy4 preview · x0.00 · 限时免费`），设置卡片会汇总当前有优惠的模型，数据以 WorkBuddy 服务端为准、每次启动 DSH 时同步。国际版促销来自服务端 `modelPromotions`（含生效时段），过期后徽章自动撤销；由于服务端把折后价直接写进模型的倍率字段，原价无法还原，此时该模型倍率显示为「价格未知 — 刷新后更新」，而不是继续显示折扣价或「免费」。

卡片展开后分「状态 / 上下文 / 明细」三个标签：状态页展示账号、令牌有效期、合计积分、模型列表来源与推理档位检测；上下文页列出各模型上下文窗口，国际版可在这里关闭「使用上游声明的最大上下文窗口」（默认开启，DSH 按上游最大窗口安排上下文压缩；关闭后改用上游默认窗口，偏好持久化）；明细页合并展示同名积分包的余量与模型优惠。国内版与国际版各有一张自己的卡片。

readme.section: 推理档位为什么这样设计
readme.text:
WorkBuddy 中模型的推理档位信息目前分散在上游接口与客户端自身的私有 UI 逻辑中，且模型目录变化很快。若插件根据经验为所有未声明模型补齐统一档位，就需要持续追赶这些未公开、没有稳定契约的产品逻辑。

实测还发现，有些模型虽然接受 `reasoning_effort` 参数，却可能忽略未知值并回退到默认行为；一次请求返回成功，并不能证明某个档位真实可用。

因此，对于没有声明档位的模型，Web 和 Desktop 采用用户主动授权触发、动态获取档位的方式：先确认上游会校验该参数，再逐项确认哪些规范档位被接受。检测会发送少量请求，可能消耗积分；结果只表示当前上游接受该档位，不承诺它一定改变推理效果、速度或积分消耗。

`dsh plugin --profile <web|dsh-tui> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status`：登录状态与剩余积分（`--json` 输出机器可读格式；另有 `doctor` 诊断、`logout` 清理凭据）。`desktop` profile 一般由桌面 App 管理，CLI（含 `exec`）对其不可用（见安装章节的 Desktop 说明）。

默认操作国内版；加 `--provider workbuddy-ai` 操作国际版：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status --provider workbuddy-ai
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-connect doctor --provider workbuddy-ai
```

`logout` 只删除该版插件自留的凭据副本，不动桌面 App 自己的登录，也不承诺一定让模型分组消失（App 的凭据文件仍在时依然生效）。

重试策略是插件配置项（`cordis.yml` 中 `llm-workbuddy` 的插件配置），国内版与国际版共用同一份；只在插件加载时读取一次，改完需重载或重启 DSH 才生效。

```yaml
llm-workbuddy:
  retryPolicy:
    mode: normal
    maxRetries: 15

- **省略整个 `retryPolicy` 即保持原行为**。显式配置时，`mode` 必填；其余可选字段按所选模式补齐默认值。未配置时沿用 `dsh-llm` 默认值——`mode: normal`、5 次重试、500 ms 起翻倍、10 s 封顶。默认值合计只有约 **15.5 秒的退避等待**（抖动区间约 14–17 秒），每次请求自身的耗时另计，因此它不构成「在固定时间窗口内必然恢复」的保证。
- **上面的示例**最多会排入约 360 秒退避（抖动上限约 396 秒），每次请求耗时再加在其上，适合覆盖数分钟级的上游中断；但同样不保证在某个固定窗口内恢复，中断更久时仍需调大 `maxRetries` 或换线路。
- `mode: always` 表示**不设次数上限**，一直重试到成功、取消或插件卸载；它不是默认值，也不会因省略配置而被启用，只有在明确接受「请求可能长时间不返回」时才使用。

- 在 macOS 的 DSH Web / Desktop / TUI 下验证通过（0.3.2 起要求 `0.1.5-rc.1`+、Node 22+；TUI 需终端界面插件 `0.10.0-beta.5` 及以上，见安装章节说明）。Windows 会依次探测 Local 与 Roaming AppData；WSL 会优先从挂载的 Windows 用户目录读取登录凭据。若 Windows 与 Linux 用户名不同且 Windows 环境变量未传入 WSL，请通过 `WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE`（国际版为 `WORKBUDDY_AI_AUTH_FILE`）指定实际位置。
- **加密桌面凭据的解密程序定位**：解密程序在 macOS 与 Windows 上会自动探测。Windows 的路径优先级为：进程中的显式配置 → 注册表配置（先用户环境变量，再系统环境变量）→ 默认安装位置 → 卸载记录自动发现；显式配置无效时会报错，不会静默换用另一个安装。国内版默认位置为 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\WorkBuddy\WorkBuddy.exe`，国际版尚无已验证的默认位置。可用 `WORKBUDDY_ELECTRON_BIN`（国内版）或 `WORKBUDDY_AI_ELECTRON_BIN`（国际版）指定可执行文件。进程变量缺失、为空或仅含空白时，Windows 会异步查询注册表；未命中的结果不缓存，因此运行中新增配置后可重试解析，实际卡片交互仍待 Windows 实机验证。成功命中的配置按实例缓存；若要改用另一个仍有效的安装路径，请完全退出并重启 DSH。macOS / Linux 设置环境变量后仍需完全重启；Linux 无法自动发现，需显式指定。WSL 下调用 Windows 侧解密程序时，插件会自动把子进程 `WSLENV` 中的 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 条目规范化为单一安全旗标（含 `/w` 转发、不做路径转换，其余条目原样保留），无需手动设置。此改动已通过离线回归测试，尚未完成 WSL2 / Windows 真机验证。
- **国际版的模型目录来自 App 界面接口**：服务端按 User-Agent 分流下发，属私有实现，上游改动可能使其失效。届时插件按「本账号上次成功目录 → 内置目录」降级，并在卡片上标明来源（实时 / 已保存 / 内置）、更新时间与失败原因，但不能保证长期兼容。国内版目录走官方 CLI 同款接口，不受此影响。
- **国际版仍未覆盖的环境**：Windows / WSL / Linux 下国际版 App 的版本读取尚未找到可靠来源，会退回最近保存的版本或内置值。macOS 上已通过真实 shim 验证 GPT 系完整回复、工具调用与续轮。
- **无凭据时的行为变化**：某

插件版本必须与 DSH 内核匹配，不匹配的组合会导致 DSH 启动失败；桌面版按其内置核心选择插件版本。本仓库从 0.8.0 起接手维护，目前适配 `0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.3`；更旧内核请使用上游 npm 历史版本，不要安装本仓库 main。

兼容性由 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`（`0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3`）声明：DSH 的兼容性预检只要发现该字段就只按它判断，`peerDependencies` 不再参与。0.8.1 及更早没有这个字段，只能靠精确钉死的 peer（`0.2.1-rc.2`）判断，所以后台内核升到 rc.3 时会把插件报成 `incompatible-version`，需要手动豁免；0.8.2 起不需要。以后每个新内核都要先实测再手工追加到这段白名单。

| DSH 内核 | 推荐版本 / 来源 | 注意事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.3` | `0.8.2`（本仓库 main 或 tag） | 当前内核线；由 `engines.dsh` 显式列为已验证内核，无需版本豁免。 |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | `0.8.2`（本仓库 main 或 tag） | 同一内核线的上一个 rc；0.8.1 及更早只能靠 peer 判断，装到 rc.3 上会被要求豁免。`0.2.0-rc.2` 与它不同，请核对 App 内置版本。 |

This is a community-maintained fork of `dsh-workbuddy-connect`, taken over by [longge1213812138](https://github.com/longge1213812138) and based on the original author [corrinehu](https://github.com/corrinehu)'s v0.7.9 (MIT). **Risk notice**: WorkBuddy has started restricting requests from unofficial clients. This fork does **not** bypass official checks or restrictions, and it does not guarantee that the private endpoints will remain usable; if the upstream tightens its checks, the plugin may stop working. Read the disclaimer at the end and assess the account risk yourself. Using the official WorkBuddy client is always the safest option.

readme.section: Maintainer guide (send this to an Agent)
readme.text:
- This fork only guarantees the cores listed in `package.json`'s `engines.dsh`; use the historical versions in the table for other cores, or smoke-test a core first and then append it to that allowlist.
- Changes that bypass WorkBuddy client checks, crack credit, or spoof identity are not accepted.
- If a private upstream API change cannot be fixed, keep the failure reason and log locations, and update Known limitations in README.
- **Works out of the box**: install and enable the plugin, then use it directly in DSH — no extra configuration.

- **CN and international side by side**: the CN app appears as the WorkBuddy group and the international one (WorkBuddy AI) as the WorkBuddy AI group; their models, accounts, and credit never mix. Each group follows only its own app's sign-in — install just the international app and only WorkBuddy AI appears, install both and both groups appear, sign out of one and that group goes away. Settings shows one card per version, each with its own account and balance.

- **Image input**: most models accept images pasted or dropped straight into the conversation (GLM-5.3-Flash, the DeepSeek-V4 series, and more); the few text-only models (e.g. GLM-5.1 / GLM-5.2 on the China endpoint) clearly say so.

- **Reasoning levels**: levels explicitly declared by WorkBuddy appear directly — for example, GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash offer low / high / max. For models without declared levels, Web and Desktop offer a manual check in the model picker (it sends a few requests and may consume credit); models without a check result or selectable levels keep using WorkBuddy's default.

- **Balance at a glance**: with a WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI model selected, the composer shows the account's remaining credit next to the model selector (e.g. `WB.3,401 credits`, `WB AI.3,401 credits` on the international app). Credit is not polled automatically (every status read is a real billing query): one read on mount, then refresh on demand with the ↻ before the balance. During session switching, the controls may briefly hide until the model selection is ready, then return automatically. The refresh button remains available even when the model has no reasoning-level detection entry or the balance cannot be read.

- **Status and detection**: Settings → Plugins → the matching card shows the account, token validity, remaining credit, and model offers; it also refreshes the model list manually, shows whether the current list came from the upstream or the built-in fallback, and runs manual reasoning-level detection for eligible models. On DSH 0.1.5 the entry lives under Settings → Plugins; on 0.1.6+ it moved to the left-sidebar Plugins panel (workbuddy-connect → View) — and the Settings → Models page shows no WorkBuddy entries on either generation, by design.

- **Model visibility**: the Context window tab of each card lets you check which models appear in the model picker. Hidden lists are saved per signed-in account: switching accounts switches to that account's own list, switching back restores it; new accounts and newly added models are visible by default. Hiding only affects pickability — existing chats using a hidden model keep working.

The same UI works unchanged inside the DSH 0.1.5 settings cards:

- **Enterprise credit**: on the CN product, enterprise accounts (non-empty `enterpriseId`) read their cycle quota from the enterprise billing endpoint, and the card shows the enterprise quota with the cycle reset time.

- **Rate**: every model name carries its credits multiplier (e.g. `GLM-5.2 · x0.79`, `Hy3 · x0.00`) in both the `/model` popup and the composer's model dropdown; the rate is display-only and never affects requests.

- **Promo badges**: promo badges (limited-time free, night discount) ride the model name itself (e.g. `Hy4 preview · x0.00 · 限时免费`), visible wherever you pick a model, and the status card collects currently discounted models — per WorkBuddy service data, synced each time DSH starts. The international version's promotions come from the service's `modelPromotions` (with an effective window); once a promotion lapses its badge is withdrawn, and because the service writes the discounted value into the model's own rate field, the original price cannot be reconstructed — the model then reports "price unavailable — refresh to update" instead of repeating the discounted rate or claiming it is free.

The expanded card has three tabs: Status shows the account, token validity, total credit, catalog source, and reasoning-level detection; Context lists each model's context window, and the international version's "use the upstream's largest declared context window" switch lives here (on by default, so DSH sizes context compression to the largest declared window; turn it off to follow the upstream default instead, and the preference persists across restarts); Details combines credit packages with the same name and shows model offers. The CN and international versions each get their own card.

readme.section: Why reasoning levels work this way
readme.text: Information about WorkBuddy models' reasoning levels is currently split between upstream API responses and private UI logic in the client, while the model catalog changes quickly. If the plugin filled in one uniform set of levels for every model without an upstream declaration, it would need to keep chasing unpublished product logic with no stable contract.

readme.section: Why reasoning levels work this way
readme.text: Testing also found that some models accept the `reasoning_effort` parameter while ignoring unknown values and falling back to their default behavior. A successful request alone therefore does not prove that a level is actually usable.

readme.section: Why reasoning levels work this way
readme.text: For models without declared levels, Web and Desktop instead use user-authorized, on-demand detection: it first confirms that the upstream validates the parameter, then checks which standard levels it accepts. The check sends a few requests and may consume credit. Its result means only that the upstream currently accepts that level; it does not promise a particular change in reasoning quality, speed, or credit use.

`dsh plugin --profile <web|dsh-tui> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status`: sign-in state and remaining credit (`--json` for machine-readable output; `doctor` for diagnostics and `logout` for credential cleanup are also available). The `desktop` profile is generally managed by the desktop app, so the CLI (including `exec`) does not work against it (see the Desktop note under Install).

Both commands target the CN version by default; add `--provider workbuddy-ai` for the international one:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status --provider workbuddy-ai
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-connect doctor --provider workbuddy-ai
```

`logout` removes only that version's plugin-owned credential copy. It leaves the desktop app's own sign-in alone and does not promise the model group will disappear (the app's credential file still supplies one).

`retryPolicy` is plugin config (the `llm-workbuddy` entry in `cordis.yml`) shared by both versions; it is read once when the plugin loads, so reload or restart DSH after editing it.

```yaml
llm-workbuddy:
  retryPolicy:
    mode: normal
    maxRetries: 15

- **Omitting the entire `retryPolicy` preserves the existing behavior**. When configuring it explicitly, `mode` is required; other optional fields use the defaults for the selected mode. Without configuration, the `dsh-llm` defaults apply, i.e. `mode: normal`, 5 retries, 500 ms doubling to a 10 s ceiling. That totals only ~**15.5 s of scheduled backoff** (≈14–17 s across the jitter range), with each attempt's own request time added on top, so it is not a guarantee of recovery within any fixed window.
- **The example above** schedules up to ~360 s of backoff (≈396 s at the jitter edge) plus request time — enough for a multi-minute upstream outage, but still not a fixed-window guarantee; a longer outage needs a higher `maxRetries` or another route.
- `mode: always` retries every failure until success, cancellation, or disposal with **no attempt cap**. It is not the default and is never enabled by omission; use it only when you accept that a request may not return for a long time.

- Verified on macOS with the DSH Web / Desktop / TUI profiles (as of 0.3.2 this requires `0.1.5-rc.1`+ and Node 22+; TUI requires the terminal UI package `0.10.0-beta.5` or newer — see the Install section). Windows probes Local and Roaming AppData in order; WSL first reads credentials from the mounted Windows user profile. If the Windows and Linux user names differ and Windows environment variables are not forwarded into WSL, point `WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` (or `WORKBUDDY_AI_AUTH_FILE` for the international version) at the actual file.
- **Encrypted desktop credential helper discovery**: the helper is auto-detected on macOS and Windows. Windows uses an explicit process setting first, then registry configuration (user environment before system environment), then the default installation, then uninstall-record discovery. An invalid explicit setting is an error, not a fallback to another installation. The CN default is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\WorkBuddy\WorkBuddy.exe`; no international default has been verified. Set `WORKBUDDY_ELECTRON_BIN` (CN) or `WORKBUDDY_AI_ELECTRON_BIN` (international) to name an executable. When the process variable is absent, empty, or whitespace-only, Windows que

The plugin version must match the DSH core — a mismatched combination fails to start DSH — and the Desktop app picks its plugin version by the bundled core. This fork has been maintained since 0.8.0 and currently targets `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.3`. For older cores, use the upstream npm historical versions; do not install this repo's main on them.

Compatibility is declared by `package.json`'s `engines.dsh` (`0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3`): as soon as DSH's compatibility preflight finds that field it judges by it alone and ignores `peerDependencies`. 0.8.1 and earlier had no such field, so the only requirement the runtime saw was the pinned peer (`0.2.1-rc.2`) — an exact version never matches another prerelease, so a core upgrade to rc.3 reported the plugin as `incompatible-version` until the person granted an exemption. 0.8.2 removes that step. Every future core still has to be smoke-tested and appended to this allowlist by hand.

| DSH core | Recommended version / source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.3` | `0.8.2` (this repo's main or tag) | Current core line; listed in `engines.dsh` as verified, so no version exemption is needed. |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | `0.8.2` (this repo's main or tag) | The previous rc of the same core line; 0.8.1 and earlier can only judge by peers and demand an exemption on rc.3. `0.2.0-rc.2` is different — check the core bundled in your Desktop app. |
| `0.2.1-rc.1` | upstream npm `0.7.7` | The core moved to `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 1.3.0, so the plugin bundles 1.3.0 too — a leftover 0.87.1 overrides entry must be removed (see the pi-ai note below). |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | upstream npm `0.7.6` | Previous core line; fixes enterprise catalog gaps and international chat requests blocked by the upstream channel check. Avoid 0.7.2 with its registry regression. |
| `0.2.0-rc.1` | upstream npm `0.7.0` | 0.7.1 drops rc.1 support; stay on this version. |
| `0.1.5` – `0.1.7` | upstream npm `0.6.5` | Final release for the old cores; 0.7.0 targets 0.2.0 only. |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | upstream npm `0.3.1` | Older line, historical maintenance only. |
| `0.1.1-rc.2` | upstream npm `0.2.6` | Older line, historic
Release history (full records at [releases](https://github.com/longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect/releases)):

- **0.8.2**: fixes the plugin being rejected as `incompatible-version` (and needing a manual exemption to start) on a DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` core. The cause was the manifest, not the code: `peerDependencies` pinned six DSH service packages to exactly `0.2.1-rc.2`, and without an `engines.dsh` field DSH's compatibility preflight compares those exact versions against the running core — and an exact version never matches another prerelease. This release adds `engines.dsh: "0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.3"` so the preflight reads only that explicit allowlist, plus a matching regression test. The interfaces the plugin actually calls are compatible on rc.3; runtime behavior is unchanged.
- **0.8.1**: fixes `dsh plugin --profile <name> exec dsh-workbuddy-connect status` failing with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` in a fresh profile because `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` was missing; adds that module as a plugin dependency. Install and host-loading behavior is unchanged; targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
- **0.8.0**: maintainer takeover; updates the repository URL, package metadata, README install and maintenance instructions, and points the update checker at this repository; code behavior is unchanged from 0.7.9 and tar

Pinned-version install example (this repo's tag):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --config.strict-dep-builds=false github:longge1213812138/dsh-workbuddy-connect#v0.8.2
```

**pi-ai versions are per core line and must not be mixed**: the 0.2.1-rc.1 core line and later (upstream 0.7.7 / 0.7.8–0.7.9, this fork 0.8.1 / 0.8.2) moved to `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 1.3.0 (bundled by the plugin), so a profile-level leftover `overrides: {'@earendil-works/pi-ai': '0.87.1'}` **must be removed** or the plugin fails to load; the 0.2.0-rc.2 core line (plugin 0.7.6) still requires `^0.87.1` — on that line, **do not** upgrade the profile-level pi-ai to 1.x, and do not act on third-party plugin managers' "updatable" prompts, which do not check peer constraints ([#86](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect/issues/86)).
